crossRefs.note: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so…
For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. In you, I take refuge. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.
For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.
in gentleness correcting those who oppose him: perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the…
and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to his will.

translations.web: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
translations.bsb: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
translations.kjv: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
translations.asv: Mine eyes are ever toward Jehovah; For he will pluck my feet out of the net.
